description: Fetches structured content from www.dota2.com including news entries and tournament bracket records (International 2012).

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_news_entry: 获取新闻文章详情，需要url参数; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_tournament_bracket: 获取锦标赛对阵表数据，需要url参数; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_tournament_game: 获取单场比赛详情，需要url参数; 参数: url; 必填: url

url.description:
要抓取的完整URL地址。
- get_news_entry: 新闻文章URL (如 https://www.dota2.com/newsentry/3398555399437783294)
- get_tournament_bracket: 对阵表URL (如 http://www.dota2.com/tournaments/international2012/mainevent/results/grandfinal/)
- get_tournament_game: 比赛详情URL (如 http://www.dota2.com/tournaments/international2012/game/40/)
